description.value: Kuo Hua Trading Co is a Taiwanese specialty supermarket and food importer, originally founded in Toronto in 1995 and expanded to Richmond in 2010 as its Vancouver flagship store. It carries over 2,000 imported Taiwanese products — from fresh produce and packaged snacks to sauces, teas, and ceramics — and serves as the exclusive Canadian agent for several major Taiwanese food brands. Touring cyclists will find a well-stocked source of Asian specialty groceries, fresh fruit, and packaged energy snacks in the heart of Richmond.
